body.text: All the actors in the play were focused on their acting. Suddenly, Arthur fell down in the corner of the stage. Jeevan quickly ran to him and realized that his heart was not beating. Jeevan started CPR. He didn’t say anything but looked at Arthur’s face from time to time, thinking, “Breathe again, please.” Arthur’s eyes were closed. A few moments later, an older man in a grey suit came through the crowd and quickly knelt next to Arthur. “I’m Walter Jacobi. I’m a doctor,” he said with a calm voice. Jeevan wiped the sweat from his forehead with his sleeve. The two men worked together to help Arthur. Soon, Arthur slowly opened his eyes. Jeevan heard him breathing again and thought, “Thank goodness. You’re back and alive.”
